scope: Windows x64 Fn-lock source candidate only. Real native transport and qualification paths are implemented; offline compilation does not establish Windows installation, UAC, driver interaction or physical Fn behavior.

source.scope: Frozen runtime and verification inputs passed local suites. Feature commit identity is recorded after signing; Windows runtime acceptance remains absent.

implemented.transport: Fixed Win32 device path and IOCTLs, deterministically initialized 4MiB request/response buffers, strict full-DWORD byte decoding and buffer guards. No arbitrary-address/IOCTL or vendor-driver installer interface.
implemented.transaction: Full-byte Fn-bit read-modify-write, fresh pre-write comparison, independent full-byte readback, typed outcomes and conditional recovery. Foreign/unknown state is not overwritten and writes are not retried automatically.
implemented.qualification: Native SMBIOS/raw DSDT, unique present PnP node, running kernel-driver SCM state, PSAPI loaded-path association, protected held driver-file identity, complete disk-file digest and catalog trust. Disk hash and these associations are not loaded-memory measurement, load-time provenance or per-device kernel attachment proof.
implemented.coordination: A validated Global writer mutex serializes this application across sessions. A protected persistent ProgramData maintenance gate blocks helpers during MSI maintenance or after uncertain maintenance failure. It is not a global OEM/firmware lock or kernel compare-and-swap.
implemented.ipc: Ordinary-user GUI/CLI authenticate a fixed protected ProgramFilesX64 installation and nonce-bound local pipe, launch only the fixed elevated helper, verify peer/process/image identity and retain actual helper lifetime/wait state. No full-GUI elevation or arbitrary executable path.
implemented.wire: Bounded one-shot framed JSON Probe/Apply protocol with strict recursive duplicate/unknown/missing field, type, depth and version validation; cached client observation is never fresh authorization.

cli.scope: Explicit Probe requires UAC; windows-fn dry-run authorizes read-only Probe then previews locally without applying. Unlike this command, generic oem set --dry-run never elevates. Applied state is not automatically reset on exit; pending helper completion is waited without retrying hardware.

implemented.gui: Explicit authorized probe, cached local preview, explicit authorized apply and pending-helper completion are connected. Runtime Windows GUI, UAC and physical keyboard behavior remain unverified.
implemented.packaging: Native Windows x64 per-machine MSI recipe, protected release manifest, asInvoker GUI/CLI and requireAdministrator helper manifests, fixed installation and no vendor-driver/service operations. Maintenance refuses an active writer instead of terminating it or resetting Fn.

support.scope: Compiled-in fixed catalog only. Candidate feature is an artifact build decision, not a runtime allowlist override or hardware acceptance. No runtime_accepted support record exists.

final_python_console.scope: Full console domain after Linux packaging feature and required-input changes; not hardware acceptance.

first_windows_compile.scope: Earlier Windows target compile before later portable-policy/strict-enumeration/trace changes; not final-source verification or Windows execution.

maintenance_dll_cross_compile.scope: Linux MinGW compile/link diagnostic only. Unknown MSVC pragmas were disabled; this is not MSVC, WiX/MSI build, DLL execution, installer maintenance or Windows runtime acceptance.

behavior_mutations.scope: Production full-byte stale binding and failed-restore outcome mutations; each failed at the expected behavior assertion.

earlier_failures_preserved: Seven CLI fixture failures lacked required full driver identity; fixtures corrected without relaxing production qualification.
Two clippy rounds caught duplicate attributes, a cloned slice and an invisible test character; corrected and final whole-suite verification passed.

deployment.scope: The existing Linux r171 installation is separate from this uninstalled Windows source candidate.

source.scope: Live source watcher at documentation time, not a finalized gap-free claim. Root will record its final result.

remaining: Commit qualified source separately; no remote publication is established by this receipt.
Run PowerShell parser/native verifier, MSVC and WiX MSI build on native Windows x64.
Verify install/upgrade/rollback/Repair/removal, protected ACLs, active-writer refusal, crash gate residue and same-product repair on Windows.
Verify both UAC consent and alternate-administrator credential paths, strict peer authentication and actual helper completion on Windows.
Validate qualified OEM driver/firmware on Windows, safe Fn write/readback/recovery, physical Fn key behavior and restart/suspend boundaries.
parity_scope: No model-wide compatibility, feature-family completion or upstream issue closure is claimed.
